name: SimpleFin Sync
description: Automatically import bank and credit-card transactions from SimpleFin, with correct balances, pending reconciliation, and internal-transfer linking.

release.notes: Accounts linked at SimpleFin after setup can now be mapped from Advanced → Accounts, without re-running setup and losing every other setting — and an account you deliberately do not want synced can be excluded instead of nagged about. Transactions imported by the addon itself (Sync now, or the in-page schedule on a tab left open) are now announced on Telegram with their needs-a-category prompt; previously only the companion's imports were, so anything the addon imported was announced nowhere. Scheduled Telegram reports also retry a momentary network failure instead of losing the whole day's report.
